my-privacy-agent.note: My Privacy Agent public MCP server (Streamable HTTP). No account, key, or sign-in. The five tools are read-only and return only information already published on myprivacyagent.com: verified opt-out guides, the documented removal route for 950+ people-search and data-broker sites, and privacy library search. They never look a person up. Account tools live on the my-privacy-agent-account server below.

my-privacy-agent-account.note: My Privacy Agent account server (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 sign-in with PKCE and dynamic client registration). On first use Grok opens My Privacy Agent's own sign-in and consent screen; after that each permission (run my check, share results with this assistant, submit these requests) is granted separately by the person at https://myprivacyagent.com/connect and can be revoked at https://myprivacyagent.com/connect/manage. Tools act only for the signed-in person: list_my_subjects, get_my_report, list_my_cases, get_case_status, request_recheck, submit_approved_plan. There is no spending permission; a request is not a removal.
